skills.name: ai-tasveer
skills.description: User AI se photo ya image banwana chahe (status ke liye ya shauk se) toh achha prompt bana ke image banwana

skills.name: call-sahayak
skills.description: Phone call karna, uthana, kaatna, call ke beech chup rehna aur baad mein WhatsApp se "baad mein baat karta hoon" bhejna

skills.name: gaana-dj
skills.description: Gaana, bhajan ya video bajana, mood ke hisaab se gaana chunna aur music control karna

skills.name: mausam-safar
skills.description: Mausam, kahin jaane ki taiyari, ya kisi jagah/cheez ke baare mein jaankari chahiye toh free tools se jawab dena

skills.name: padhai-focus
skills.description: User padhai ya kaam pe focus karna chahe toh timer, break aur chhota recap wala focus session chalana

skills.name: phone-care
skills.description: Battery kam ho, phone garam ya slow ho, torch/volume theek karna ho toh phone ka khayal rakhna

skills.name: samay-sahayak
skills.description: Alarm, timer, yaad dilana, din-tareekh ka kaam bina galti ke karna

skills.name: screenshot-share
skills.description: Screen ka screenshot lena aur use WhatsApp pe kisi ko bhejna ya status lagana

skills.name: status-maker
skills.description: User WhatsApp status lagana ya hatana chahe (text, photo, AI image) toh achha status banane ka tarika

skills.name: subah-briefing
skills.description: User "good morning", "aaj ka update do" ya "din kaisa hai" bole to ek hi baar mein poora subah ka update dena

skills.name: whatsapp-sahayak
skills.description: WhatsApp pe message bhejna, reply, padhna ya delete karna ho toh bina galti ke sahi tarika

skills.name: yaadein-saathi
skills.description: User kuch yaad rakhne, yaad dilane ya bhoolne ko kahe, ya apne baare mein kuch bataye toh Yaadein sahi se sambhalna
